query: SELECT sec.login AS aim_login_aim ,sec.employee_id AS emp_id_aim ,CONCAT(emp.fname, ' ', emp.lname) AS name_aim ,cont.cell_phone AS cell_phone_aim ,cont.o_phone AS office_phone_aim ,cont.h_phone AS home_phone_aim  FROM ae_s_sec_c sec LEFT JOIN ae_h_emp_cont_data cont ON  sec.multitenant_id=cont.multitenant_id AND sec.employee_id=cont.shop_person LEFT JOIN ae_h_emp_e emp ON  cont.multitenant_id=emp.multitenant_id AND cont.shop_person=emp.shop_person  WHERE sec.active = 'Y'
